# PlaybackControls

Transport for timeline replay: jump to start, step back, play/pause, step forward, jump to end, plus a speed switch.

`CLR.PlaybackControls` · History

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.PlaybackControls playing position={0} duration={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.PlaybackControls" playing="{{yes}}" position="{{0}}" duration="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (PlaybackControlsProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `playing` * | `boolean` |  |
| `position` * | `number` | Seconds from session start. |
| `duration` * | `number` |  |
| `speed` * | `1 \| 2 \| 5 \| 10` |  |
| `onPlayPause` * | `() => void` |  |
| `onStep` * | `(direction: -1 \| 1) => void` |  |
| `onJump` * | `(to: 'start' \| 'end') => void` |  |
| `onSeek` * | `(seconds: number) => void` |  |
| `onSpeed` * | `(speed: PlaybackSpeed) => void` |  |
